-

Manufacturing jobs directly contribute to some of the world’s most transformative products, including life-impacting medical devices and mission-critical aerospace and defense systems.


## How Does National Manufacturing Month Help Highlight Careers at Plexus?


This National Manufacturing Month,[Plexus](https://www.plexus.com/about/) is celebrating the important role manufacturing plays in global innovation while showcasing direct hire manufacturing jobs that support life-impacting products and technologies.


The global manufacturing industry drives technological advancements that impact lives across the world. At Plexus, we help create the products that build a better world. Our team solves complex design, manufacturing and servicing challenges for companies operating in highly regulated markets. From life-saving[medical](https://www.plexus.com/market-sectors/healthcare-life-sciences/) devices to mission-critical aerospace and[defense](https://www.plexus.com/market-sectors/aerospace-defense/) systems, our daily work turns complex ideas into physical products.


National Manufacturing Month provides an opportunity to recognize the skill and dedication of our global team members. It also serves as an invitation for job candidates seeking impactful work to join our team. Direct employment at Plexus offers health and wellness benefits starting on day one, structured training and career progression. Choosing a career with Plexus means joining an organization dedicated to growing our people, delivering excellence and partnering with leading companies to create transformative products.


## How Do Plexus Manufacturing Capabilities and Sites Deliver Excellence?


Plexus delivers excellence through advanced technical capabilities, including surface-mount technology (SMT), complex assembly, cleanroom manufacturing and system integration. Our United States manufacturing footprint includes facilities in Neenah, Wisconsin; Boise, Idaho and Chicago, Illinois.


SMT capabilities allow our facilities to place microscopic components on printed circuit board assemblies with extreme precision. Our team members manage high-tech production lines and automated inspection systems that meet rigorous quality standards. These advanced environments ensure that sensitive electronics for healthcare and aerospace applications remain free from environmental contamination.


Each of our sites maintain modern facility standards, comprehensive safety protocol and team recognition programs. Our focus on continuous improvement encourages team members to share ideas that enhance efficiency, safety and operations.


## What Career Opportunities Are Available within Manufacturing at Plexus?


Manufacturing career opportunities at Plexus include immediate direct-hire roles for Production Operators and Technicians, offering day-one benefits, hands-on training and career growth opportunities.


Our people-centered culture helps you be fulfilled through base pay and pathways to advance into higher-paying roles. You will thrive in wellbeing with day-one health and dental coverage, a 401(k) plan, mental and financial resources and supportive time off. Through hands-on training, you can grow with purpose as your advancement is driven by your performance, desire to learn and drive to reach your full potential. You will also enjoy where you work in a clean, temperature-controlled facility focused on your safety and comfort, while feeling that you belong here within a supportive team culture built on mutual respect and active internal groups.


### What Do Production Operators Do in Electronics Manufacturing Careers?


Production Operators build circuit board assemblies, electronic sub-assemblies and finished products using detailed visual instructions, specialized tools and automated machinery.


As Production Operators, team members work in a clean, climate-controlled environment while performing a wide range of tasks, including operating automated machinery, hands-on assembly, quality inspection and specialized technical processes that support our high-tech printed circuit board manufacturing.


Attention to detail and quality verification are core responsibilities for this role. Operators inspect parts along the assembly line to verify that every unit meets strict safety and quality standards before moving to the next production stage.


### What Responsibilities do Technicians have at Plexus?


Manufacturing Technicians focus on product manufacturing processes, troubleshooting complex assembly and build instructions used to create circuit boards. They also program and maintain automated equipment to ensure machines meet quality standards and circuit boards are built to customer specifications.


Test Technicians verify that high-reliability electronics perform correctly under demanding conditions. Team members set up and operate specialized test equipment, execute functional testing and analyze electronic assemblies to determine if precision repairs are needed.


Equipment Technicians keep production lines operating smoothly. These Technicians perform preventative maintenance and configure equipment for new product builds. They also collaborate directly with engineers to resolve technical challenges on the manufacturing floor.


## How Can Job Seekers Apply for Manufacturing Jobs at Plexus Today?


Job candidates can apply for manufacturing jobs at Plexus by visiting the[Plexus careers](https://plexus.eightfold.ai/careers?utm_source=plexus-blog&utm_medium=website-blog&utm_campaign=q1f27-amer-plexus-national-manufacturing-month-website-blog) site, searching open positions by location and submitting an online application.


Ready to make an impact and help create the products that build a better world?


Applicants can begin their journey through three simple action steps:


1. Visit the official Plexus Careers site.
2. Search for open Production Operator and Technician positions by location, such as Neenah, Boise or Chicago.
3. Submit your application online today to join our team.
